prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-01-22, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-01-22):
Price action as of 2026-01-22: 1w +1.5%, 1m +9.5%, 3m +9.1%. Last close 85.81. 21d annualized realized volatility 22%. Position in trailing 63-day range: 100% (0%=low, 100%=high).
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock exhibits strong positive momentum across all short-to-medium-term timeframes (1-week, 1-month, and 3-month) and has just closed at its 63-day high (100th percentile). Supported by a moderate 22% annualized realized volatility, this upward trend suggests strong buying pressure and a high probability of continued short-term gains over the next 20 trading days. 

DECISION: BUY
